method.counts: samplePointsInWindowAfterFirst counts recorded points after the raw first sample, independently of duration weighting.
method.allFunctionTable: Complete frame accounting is a columns/rows matrix; top ranking lists are navigation only. Rows preserve every observed frame, including pre-import-only frames and zero recurring weights.
